en: I'll crush the Tojo Clan.
Every last one of them down in Fukuoka.
Yer quittin' on me!?
Yes, sir. I don't want to cause you any more trouble.
You've known all along, haven't you? That my name isn't actually Suzuki.
Well, yeah.
The truth is, I'm ex-yakuza. I used to be in a group called the Tojo Clan.
Eventually I made a clean start, and went on to run an orphanage in Okinawa.
Then I had to leave, and ended up here in Fukuoka. That's when I met you.
But now, war is about to break out here in Fukuoka between the Tojo Clan and the Yamagasa Family.
War!?
I have to stop that from happening.
Suzuki-san...
No matter how things turn out, it would be a huge problem for you if word got out that I worked here.
Meaning I need to quit before that happens.
So that's how it is, huh?
I'm sorry it had to be this way.
Yeah, so am I. 'Cause you ain't goin' nowhere.
But Chief.
Look. You're sayin' you wanna quit 'cause you're afraid of hurtin' the company, right?
Well, you're goin' about this all wrong. You don't hafta leave. Yer part of the family now, Suzuki-san.
I want the people workin' for me to live life true to themselves, without holdin' anything back.
I could tell you were no ordinary guy right from the get-go.
Truth be told, I had a feelin' somethin' like this would happen one day.
Bear in mind, I'm runnin' a business here. I can't afford to lose a good man for no good reason.
Now I don't need to know any details. Just be sure to come back to us, no matter what.
Y'got that?
Nakajima-san...
Right! Now that that's settled, you better take care of any loose ends before the big task ahead!
Oh, and y'can take one of our cars when you go and put an end to this war of yours. Just come talk to me.
Thank you, Chief.
So Madarame came begging you to rescue his helpless family, did he?
Madarame is still alive and strong. You failed to destroy the Yamagasa Family.
For someone who made it so far, you really are quite imperceptive.
I never wanted to kill Madarame.
All I needed was to ruffle up his feathers a bit. That was the plan all along.
Did the bomb not give it away?
If I wanted to use lethal force, I wouldn't use a half-measure. I'd have guaranteed the deed was done.
That little display of fireworks was simply the pretext I needed to fight the Yamagasa Family.
Besides, having Madarame die would be <Italic>very</Italic> inconvenient for me, at least until Chairman Dojima turns up.
I know for a fact the two of them had something worked out. So I needed proper bait to lure out the chairman.
I get it. You're using Madarame to get to Daigo.
As far as Chairman Dojima's concerned, I intend to track him down as soon as possible.
Now then, I think it's time we began. Are you ready, Fourth Chairman?
I need to check one thing first.
And what might that be?
If I take you all down myself, then this isn't a war between the families, right?
I really don't know what you're implying.
I meant what I said. If I take down every one of you myself, it's just a fight between a civilian and some yakuza.
Not a war between families. Am I wrong?
That's absurd! Have you lost your mind?
Yahata! You stay out of this. I promise, I won't leave a single one standing.
But!
Like I said, I won't let your family fade away.
Hahahaha! What nonsense. You must've taken too many hits to the head.
You won't be laughing soon.
So you're going to take on an army by yourself because you think you can stop a war!?
You don't stand a chance!
(We'll see about that.)
(Well, that's done. Just gotta make sure I'm ready, then I'm off to the battin' center.)
Dammit... You're too freaking strong!
Ya want my advice? Find a new line of work. You'll be happier for it.
Hah... Hahaha! Like there's somewhere else that'll take a guy like me.
If ya can't find anythin', come see me.
Gonna be leavin' town for a while tonight, but I'll be back someday. If you're still flounderin' by then, I'll give ya a hand up.
Oh, uh... Thanks.
(Well, that took longer than I was hopin'. Better get to New Serena before it's too late.)
Can I help you?
Ya got cotton shoved in your ears? I asked you a question.
I'm sick of you and your whole tough guy shtick.
Ya gonna explain that, or can I go? Got places to be.
Not so fast. You're the reason my career's gone down the shitter.
N' how's that, exactly?
Don't play dumb! If your criminal ass didn't come waltzing back into the Tojo Clan, I'd have been lieutenant by now!
Huh. So you're Tojo, too.
Ever since you filled that empty exec seat, we've been getting screwed. Over and over and over again!
First our casino got busted, then the cops raided the family office. Bye bye, main revenue stream!
Most of our boys ended up scurrying off not long after. Rats who can see the ship is sinking fast.
So what's left of us now? We got no money, no men. Hell, we're barely even a family.
Tough break.
Tough break? Is that all you have to say!?
Lemme ask ya somethin'. When things started goin' south, what did you do?
Your casino got busted. Ya got raided by the cops.
Your family fell on its ass quicker than ya can count to ten. I wanna know, how'd ya respond?
I, well...
What was I supposed to do? I can't turn that shit around all by myself!
There. Now do ya see why you ain't a leader?
Sure, maybe my comin' back tossed a few pebbles in your path.
But if a pebble or two are gonna make ya fall flat on your face, how're ya ever gonna climb the mountains life's got in store?
So yeah, ya might slip a bit here n' there. But what really matters is how ya respond after.
If the family means that much to ya, you gotta be willin' to give your life on keepin' it afloat.
Else you just ain't cut out for the yakuza, pal.
I don't need a fucking lecture from <Italic>you</Italic>!
You know what? I'm sick of your shit! Get ready to die!
Easy there. I'm skippin' town for good after tonight.
Let me enjoy my last evenin' in peace.
No way, man! Not after the sermon you just made us sit through!
Ahhh, that was good shit! Couldn't shove down another bite if I wanted. So, what're ya doin' now?
They're comin' for me tonight. Guess I'll take one last stroll around town.
Now there's a hell of an idea. Ya oughta have a good time before goin' away.
So get on out there n' live it up.
Think I will.
Oh yeah. Stop in n' see me before they haul you in, so I can give ya a proper send-off. I'll be waitin' at the usual place!
Y'know! What's the one place we're always pallin' around at?
Heh. The battin' center, then.
So whaddya say? One last chance at the plate before ya get benched?
(Time to wave this town goodbye.)
(Might wanna drop by New Serena first, tell 'em I'm goin'.)
Uh-oh, angry face! You maaad about something?
It's me you want. You didn't need to drag Baba into this.
Of course I did. He's the one who stabbed my boy!
Poor Owada, he'll be feeling that for the rest of his life.
You're gonna regret this.
Whooooa, tough guy, what are you saying?
You going to pull a Baba and stab us? Hehehe...
This is the chisel they say Baba used. It's yours, ain't it?
Your tools have disappeared from the woodshop. Only yours.
I know ya threatened Baba and dragged him off.
So quit playin' dumb and fess up!
Moron. Why would you even want to help that waste of space?
It's not like they'll move up your parole.
I don't give two shits about that. Right now you and I are goin' to the guards and settlin' this.
Baba-chan was up for parole. And then you had to screw it all up!
Well, if he'd only been a good little boy, he could've avoided all this.
He should have been more obedient.
Heh, last night I ordered him to kill you in your sleep, as soon as you were out of solitary.
Hey, it's not like I asked him to do it for free! I'm a reasonable man... I promised your boy a job when he got out.
Since his family ditched him, he's been scared shitless about being out there all alone. All I did was try to help him.
But your idiot boy said no. After I was so generous!
So, I applied a little discipline. Bye-bye, parole!
Here's how I made it go down...
(Fuckin' bastard...)
First, I had my men fight themselves.
Hehe, and the chisel stabbing⑬I must admit that was my favorite part. One of my better ideas.
Then little Baba comes along.
I pretend that I'm breaking up the scuffle, and I hand the chisel to Baba.
He didn't even think twice⑬he just took it! Haha! And of course, you know the rest.
How'd it go?
Hah. I've had farts tougher to sneak out.
Yup. It's been done.
Way to go, Heihachiro!
Idiot! Keep your voice down.
Oh, uh, sorry...
You sure you were a detective, Himura?
I'll have you know, I was considered pretty sharp in the precinct.
So the chisel. Whose was it?
Just as we thought, it belongs to that Kugihara creep.
Number 134... Yep, it's his.
We should take this to Kosaka right away.
(Whew... That should do it.)
*huff* *wheeze* Wha⑬ What have you got there!? Show it!
You mean this?
You handed over the <Color:8>Mystery Envelope<Color:Default>.
What? An envelope? There's a note inside...
"Nice jog"!? You bastard!
(Sorry, guardman... Just indulgin' some old-timer's weird sense of humor.)
Big demerits are coming down on you, let me tell ya! What's your name? Saejima, right?
(Great, just great...)
(Don't know what to do here.)
I asked you a question! What do you want?
You little⑬!
Hey! Freeze!
So we know the chisel came from the woodworking crew. Now we just need to figure out exactly who owns it.
We could do that if we just got our hands on it.
Yeah, but the guards took it when they hauled off Baba.
All we need is a quick glance. Maybe a guard will let us see it...
Heh. Sure, we'll just put in a check-out request with the guard shank library. Easy.
Okay. Point taken.
*sigh* In fact, if a guard catches wind of this at all, we're all going to end up in solitary.
So, any other bright ideas?
Yeah. Let me do what I'm good at.
Which is what?
Stealing shit.
You can't be serious. Do you know what'll happen if you get caught?
Yup, I do.
This is prison, man! If you get nabbed stealing from a guard, solitary is the least of your problems!
Hell, they could even extend your sentence...
Don't worry. I won't get caught.
Wait... Are you...?
Over 15,000 counts of theft, zero arrests. Behold, Businessman Heihachiro.
Yeah, I've heard of you! When I made detective, you were already a legend.
The talk was you'd retired, but listening to the stories, I started to doubt you ever really existed.
High praise for a thief. If you're as good as ya say, with zero arrests, how'd ya end up in the slammer?
I turned myself in. For my sixtieth birthday.
All those years, my crimes were a secret I kept from my wife.
Every day, I pretended to be a businessman, put on a suit and tie, and went out on my heists.
Yeah, that's why you were Businessman Heihachiro...
I promised myself that I'd leave the life behind on my sixtieth birthday.
But on that day, I came home to find my wife gone.
Whoa, what'd she do? Commit suicide after finding you out?
What? No! Geez, you're desperate for entertainment. No... She left me. For another man.
Haha...
Shut up! Don't you see what I realized that day? All that time I was thieving, I hadn't noticed I was the one being robbed... of the most valuable thing in the world.
I was disgusted with myself. So I turned myself in.
...Everyone's got a story.
A big yakuza boss, a legendary thief, and a detective.
Yup, there's really no telling who you'll come across in life.
I swore I'd never steal again, but I'll do it for Baba.
I can swipe that chisel from the guards, guaranteed.
Fine. It's all on you.
All right, Oshima-san will deal with that issue...
And us?
We should collect witness accounts. As many as we can.
We've got some time, since Kugihara's gang is being interrogated by the guards right now.
When we're done, we'll meet up here again.
When you say witness accounts, what kinda info you lookin' for?
Well, we already know where the chisel came from⑬the woodworking crew. But we need to find out who was using it.
We combine that intel with the appearance of the chisel itself, and that should be enough evidence to prove Baba-chan's innocence.
Got it. I know a guy. I'll ask him.
Ten-four. I'll chase up other leads. Later, then!
(I'm bein' watched. S'pose just runnin' up is too obvious.)
(Better turn around and try again.)
(I'm bein' watched. They suspicious?)
